description: Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and MCP Code Mode. Works with any SDK or agent and adds under 200µs of overhead at 5k RPS.
Coding agent memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 40 more, built from the session history already on your disk. Local search, MCP and hooks, no LLM, one Go binary.
eBPF Observability - Distributed Tracing and Profiling
Distributed AI Model Training and LLM Fine-Tuning on Kubernetes
The most powerful MCP Slack Server with no permission requirements, Apps support, GovSlack, DMs, Group DMs and smart history fetch logic.
